title: Blinding Lights
hook: Why Blinding Lights feels *like a night drive alone*
cover_text: The chord that *lights up the dark*

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: Home: *F minor*. Dark streets, neon glow.

chords.name: Eb
chords.text: *E♭ major* starts to climb. Lights ahead.

chords.name: Bb
chords.text: *B♭ major* brings D natural: sudden headlights.

chords.name: Fm
chords.text: Back to F minor. *Still alone, still racing*.

question: Which 80s song does this remind you of? 👇
